ops.title: long-running: fold orca-worker-launch and orca-reclaim into lr launch worker and lr gc
ops.description: The monorepo orca skill's launcher and reclaimer were carried into the pack verbatim as orca-worker-launch and orca-reclaim (meta-desk-2 pick 3, lane orca-scripts-move-1), beside lr launch worker and lr gc, which diverged from them. Converge to one implementation: lr launch worker takes a plain Sprite launch without WORKER_CHECKOUT, WORKER_CCI_URL, WORKER_CCI_SHA256 or an lr pin; gains the Run-scoped local worktree name, the never-cut-twice guard, WORKER_SPARSE, and the one-attempt-per-brief rule (or the owner rules the relaunch-after-failure behaviour wins); lr gc gains the ten-minute quiet check, a Linux session scan where ps -axE fails, and closes idle terminals in kept trees, or each difference gets an owner ruling. Then the orca-* bins become lr shims and the monorepo calls the one tool.

ops.text: orca-worker-launch and orca-reclaim exec lr verbs through bin-shim.sh, and their Python and bash sources are deleted
Every behavior difference listed in the body is either carried by lr or ruled out by the owner, with the ruling cited in the PR
